findings.description: When the final attempt fails, the loop hits `break` and the method falls off the end, returning None. settle_invoice only catches GatewayError, so it takes the success path: it sets the invoice to PAID and reads `charge.id` on None, raising AttributeError. The failed-charge handling (PAYMENT_FAILED) is never reached, and the AttributeError aborts the whole settle_open_invoices batch, leaving the remaining invoices unsettled.
findings.suggestion: Re-raise the last GatewayError after the final attempt (replace `break` with `raise`), or raise a new GatewayError after the loop.
